title: BUGFIX — generate-phase1-5-gate: mark views unverifiable when TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN absent
rationale: Same issue as Sprint 1341 (generate-gate-report.ts) but in generate-phase1-5-gate.ts. When TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN is not set, total_views stays 0 and passesViews = false, causing the phase1-5-gate.json to show pass: false on views and overall_pass: false. gate-check-cron.ts reads this file and exits 1 (FAIL) when overall_pass is false, potentially triggering alerts. Fix: detect token absence + zero views → set passesViews = null (unverifiable), treat as non-blocking in overallPass, add note to criteria details, update urgency not to trigger KILL SWITCH based on unverifiable views.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/generate-phase1-5-gate.ts: check process.env.TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN. If absent and totalViews === 0, set viewsUnverifiable = true. Update passesViews to null when unverifiable. Update overallPass: passesPostCount && (passesViews || viewsUnverifiable). Update getUrgencyLevel to not return PASSED unless views are verifiable OR unverifiable. Update criteria details to include note about missing token. Update process.exit to not exit 1 based on unverifiable views.
